title: Sparta's Disgusting Black Broth
hook: Spartan warriors ate a soup of boiled pig blood and vinegar that terrified neighboring city-states.

scenes.text: In ancient Sparta, luxurious food was strictly outlawed to keep citizen soldiers hardened, lean, and indifferent to comfort.

scenes.text: Every Spartan male ate his daily meals in a communal mess hall called a syssitia, where the staple dish was 'melas zomos'—Black Broth.

scenes.voicedText: Every Spartan male ate his daily meals in a communal mess hall called a syssitia, where the staple dish was 'melas zomos'—Black Broth.

scenes.text: The recipe was notorious: boiled pork legs, pig blood, salt, and vinegar—the acid preventing the congealed blood from clotting completely.

scenes.voicedText: The recipe was notorious: boiled pork legs, pig blood, salt, and vinegar—the acid preventing the congealed blood from clotting completely.

scenes.text: A visiting traveler from the wealthy city of Sybaris once tasted the broth and famously joked: 'Now I understand why Spartans are so eager to die in battle!'
